evidence.quote: at some point it will be appropriate to reduce the level of policy restriction to maintain a healthy balance in the economy.
Beyond that, I see inflation slowing more sharply next year
In that case, monetary policy would need to respond to such a threat to the employment side of the dual mandate.
But recent data, including first-quarter household spending and retail sales for April and May, suggest that growth is slowing.
However, after rapid disinflation in the second half of last year, progress has slowed this year.
I see the risks to achieving our employment and inflation goals as having moved toward better balance.
